## Make species matrices

This matrix has species from all sites, years, and subplots together

```{r}
tot_matrix <- data |> 
  select(4:last_col()) |> 
  as.matrix()
```
 
### Test of Rao QE

Rao calculated with my own function:

```{r}
FD <- rao(dat = tot_matrix, distances = dissims$overall, equivalent = F)
```
Let's check against melodic as reference:

```{r}
FD_melodic <- melodic(tot_matrix, dissims$overall)
FD_melodic <- FD_melodic$abundance$rao

all.equal(FD, FD_melodic)
```

The two functions are equivalent, down to numerical accuracy.

### Data grouped by site

These are the same steps as above, but splitting the data by site.

```{r}
site <- split(data, data$plot)

#get species as matrix
site_mat <- lapply(site, function (x) as.matrix(x[, 4:ncol(x)]))

#remove missing species columns (for randomization)
site_mat <- lapply(site_mat, function(x){
  x <- x[, which(colSums(x) > 0)]
})
```

### Data grouped by year

Again the same steps, but split by year.

```{r}
year <- split(data, data$date)

#get species as matrix
year_mat <- lapply(year, function (x) as.matrix(x[, 4:ncol(x)]))

#remove missing species columns (for randomization)
year_mat <- lapply(year_mat, function(x){
  x <- x[, which(colSums(x) > 0)]
})
```

```{r}
library(plotly)

scatter <- function(df, var1, var2) {
  df |> 
    select(all_of(var1), all_of(var2), species) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[var1]], y = .data[[var2]])) +
    geom_point(aes(label = species)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

traits |> 
  scatter("ln", "sla") |> 
ggplotly()

traits |> 
  scatter("la", "sm") |> 
ggplotly()
```

There seems to be nothing unexpected with the trait data.

## Randomizations

Make a function for constrained randomization, which subsets the dissimilarity matrix by keeping species present in the data. `distswap()` is documented in the functions script.

```{r}
constrainedswap <- function (x, dis, n = 1000){
    dis_sub <- dis[colnames(x), colnames(x)] #keep species in subset
    swap <- distswap(dis_sub, n)
    return(swap)
}
```

### Unconstrained randomizations
The first function, `distswap()`, permutes the lower triangle of the distance matrix, then transposes and copies it to the upper triangle. `SESrao()` takes the observed and simulated data and calculates SES based on Rao or Equivalent Rao.
I am also checking skewness of the distribution of the simulated FD in each subplot.

```{r}
set.seed(123)

#make arrays of 1000 randomizations
randos <- lapply(dissims, function (x) distswap(x, 1000))
#calculate SES
SES <- map2(dissims, randos,
            \(x, y) SESrao(tot_matrix, dissim = x, rand = y, which = "dissim", equivalent = F))

#bind into tibble
results_all <- data[1:3] |> 
  bind_cols(SES) 

datatable(results_all)
rm(randos, SES, tot_matrix)
```

### Within sites
In constrained randomization, dissim is subset using the local pool.

```{r}
set.seed(124)

results_sites <- tibble()

for (i in seq_along(site_mat)){
  species_site <- site_mat[[i]]
  rando_site <- lapply(dissims, function (x) constrainedswap(species_site, x))
  SES_site <-  map2(dissims, rando_site, 
                   \ (x, y) SESrao(species_site, x, y, which = "dissim", equivalent = F))
  res_site <- site[[i]][1:3] |> 
    bind_cols(SES_site)
  results_sites <- bind_rows(results_sites, res_site)
}

rm(species_site, rando_site, SES_site, site_mat, res_site)
```

### Within years

```{r}
set.seed(125)

results_years <- tibble()

for (i in seq_along(year_mat)){
  species_year <- year_mat[[i]]
  rando_year <- lapply(dissims, function (x) constrainedswap(species_year, x))
  SES_year <-  map2(dissims, rando_year, 
                    \ (x, y) SESrao(species_year, x, y, which = "dissim", equivalent = F))
  res_year <- year[[i]][1:3] |> 
    bind_cols(SES_year)
  results_years <- bind_rows(results_years, res_year)
}

rm(species_year, rando_year, SES_year, year_mat, res_year)
```

## Save results

```{r}
save(results_all, results_sites, results_years, file = "intermediate/SES.RData")
```
